sampling_model.design: Independent multinomial sampling from the selected law \(p=P(E,W,Z\mid S=1)\), with an independent margin multinomial sample in design A when margins are estimated and \(n/n_m\to\lambda\in(0,\infty)\).
sampling_model.units: Each unit contributes one draw of \((E,W,Z)\) conditional on \(S=1\); the finite SCM is a superpopulation model.
sampling_model.treatment: \(X\) is binary and may be confounded with the response type; in design B its assignment probability may depend on \((U,Z)\).
sampling_model.overlap: All population selected cells are positive. A nonempty supplied-margin fiber forces every population cell margin to be positive. Wald inference additionally requires separated incident charts, common first derivatives, smooth local continuations, and target covariance bounded away from singularity; Hausdorff equivalence of profile and Wald regions also requires a locally saturated compatible observable neighborhood.
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: Reduced selected-table and independent margin coordinates use empirical multinomial frequencies and the block-diagonal plug-in covariance. The deterministic chart selector uses the stated tolerance and full-square fallback. Transition inference profiles the exact multinomial discrepancy over the complete compatible target fiber and applies Berger--Boos calibration; this gives finite-sample coverage even when chart selection or point identification fails.

comparator_promise_table.comparator_claim: Theorem 1 and Corollary 1 identify PN and PS under positive observed tables, invertible proxy matrices, and unequal determinant-ratio conditions.
Formula (5) identifies a causal effect under a proxy rank condition without identifying the measurement mechanism.
Proposition 3.3 characterizes infinitesimal rigidity of an exact nonnegative factorization by its admissible-motion cone.
Theorems 5--9 give necessary support conditions and sufficient sequential recovery conditions for selected NMF factors.
Theorem 1 gives sufficient positive-scattering thresholds for minimality and uniqueness of nonnegative tensor decompositions.
Theorem 3.4 gives a regular root-n estimator for a linear proximal target without uniqueness of the bridge solution.

Theorem 1 identifies all four response-type probabilities in a randomized experiment under positive conditional tables, \(W\perp Z\mid U\), \(X\perp(U,Z,W)\), invertible cell matrices, and unequal determinant ratios; equations (8)--(11) give plug-in estimators.

Theorem 1 identifies all four joint probabilities of binary potential-outcome types under Figure 2(b)'s IV-plus-proxy recursive factorization, the five invertibility requirements in condition (i), the cross-treatment second-column separation in condition (ii), and the two exclusion restrictions in condition (iii).

Theorems 2--5 give sound closed-form bounds for a representative family of discrete probabilities of causation from standard experimental and observational distributions, while general-dimensional tightness remains open in the current version.
Conditional quasi-likelihood-ratio tests have uniformly correct asymptotic size without strong identification.
E-variable inversion yields exact anytime-valid confidence sets for contingency-table parameters.
Theorem 4 identifies PN and PS under exogeneity and monotonicity, and equations (15)--(18) give sharp bounds otherwise.

body.tldr: For every fixed finite four-response-type selected proxy model, a boundary-complete structural atlas decides PN/PS target rigidity. It exhausts rank-two orientations, all disjoint L/R/E/D rank-one modes, equal-endpoint splits, inactive rows, and the relevant-IV residual forests. After checking the supplied design-A margin, it samples one feasible cycle point and asks every chart whether a different target is realizable. The output is an exact common target, legal same-observable SCM twins, or incompatibility. The published regular formulas transfer by restriction in design A and through equation (13) and Corollary 1 in design B; the new contribution is classification only on additional compatible singular and boundary laws. Fixed-alphabet sample-record and algebraic-degree bounds are singly exponential, while rational height has a separate conservative bound. Exact confidence-fiber coverage remains universal, whereas Wald and Hausdorff equivalence remain confined to their already accepted separated and locally saturated regimes.

project_justification.gap: Published regular proxy formulas do not classify PN/PS constancy when ranks fall, coefficients reach support faces, endpoints coincide, response rows become inactive, or shared-instrument equations couple unknown population margins. General decidability also does not expose the causal response-cycle obstruction or distinguish incompatibility from nonidentification.
project_justification.niche: The four response types form a labeled causal cycle whose target may be rigid while nuisance factorizations vary. Exhaustive rank-two and L/R/E/D edge charts with shared endpoints and residual forests reduce the full fiber to finitely many one-copy semialgebraic sets. One common sampled target can then be compared against every chart without enumerating connected components or introducing a two-copy classifier.
project_justification.fill: The compiler first checks strict supplied-margin compatibility in design A and chart feasibility in both designs. From one feasible sample it performs an unequal-target existential test on every chart, returning an exact target, legal target-changing full SCMs, or incompatibility. The regular anchor is stated exactly as a Condition-1 fixed-margin restriction for design A and an equation-(13) relevant-IV subclass for design B. Its termination theorem counts structural templates and composes only bounded algebraic sampling and existential-realizability bounds, with algebraic degree obtained by multiplying extension degrees and rational height reported separately.

body.related_work: Shingaki, Yoshida, and Kuroki (2026) supply the selected response-type factorization and the regular identification results used here. At the selected-law factorization level, the present finite four-type model specializes their Condition 1. The fixed-margin two-proxy fiber is a restriction to which Theorem 1 applies, while the relevant-IV fiber satisfies equation (13) and relevance, so Corollary 1 applies directly. Our contribution does not extend their regular formula or subsume their model; it classifies additional compatible singular and boundary fibers and reports incompatible inputs separately. Shingaki and Kuroki (2023) and Kawakami (2021) provide separate experimental and IV-plus-proxy overlap results under their own conditions. Nonnegative-factorization rigidity work supplies geometric context but not causal target constancy on this labeled response cycle. Basu, Pollack, and Roy (2006) supply the exact bounded-algebraic-sampling, existential-realizability, real-univariate, sign, and root-isolation algorithms used only after structural exhaustiveness is proved.
body.technical_internal_limitation: The atlas is a theorem-level exact symbolic procedure, not a claim of a completed production implementation or favorable growing-alphabet complexity. Connected-component descriptions may be produced diagnostically but are not required for the rigidity decision. Over arbitrary real observables, computation is relative to effective coefficient-field arithmetic, order, sign-determination, and real-root oracles. A rational expression is returned only when constructed; otherwise the result remains a real-univariate and Thom encoding. The singly exponential statement covers fixed-alphabet record count and algebraic degree only. Rational coefficient and isolating-endpoint height obey the separately displayed power bound and are not advertised as singly exponential. Strictly positive twins require both cycle witnesses to lie in interior support charts. The accepted exact-coverage and locally saturated Hausdorff qualifications are unchanged. The released numerical GEUVADIS count table and binarization thresholds remain unavailable in the frozen materials, so no numerical dataset verdict is asserted.
body.honest_scope: The mathematical contribution is the exhaustive fixed-alphabet response-cycle classifier and its one-sample/all-chart rigidity test. Design-A margins outside the strict interior and empty chart unions are reported as incompatibility, which is non-rigid under the cardinality-one definition. The regular two-proxy result transfers only by restricting Condition 1 to a fixed population margin, and the regular IV result transfers through equation (13) and Corollary 1; the atlas adds compatible singular and boundary classification, not a new regular formula or blanket subsumption. Record/output count and normalized algebraic degree receive singly exponential fixed-alphabet bounds by sequential sampling, existential realizability, and explicit multiplication of extension degrees. Rational height receives a separate conservative bound. The statistical Wald, exact-coverage, and locally saturated Hausdorff scopes remain unchanged. The GEUVADIS application remains an audit protocol conditional on the graph and recovery of the actual released table, not a new numerical reanalysis.
